svg.title: Attention removes the single-vector bottleneck
svg.desc: CNN language models use fixed windows, RNNs process sequentially, and basic seq2seq compresses input into one state. Attention lets decoder states directly access encoder states.

g.text: CNN windows are fixed; RNNs are sequential; attention directly retrieves encoder states.
FROM FIXED WINDOWS TO DIRECT SOURCE LOOKUP
attention: decoder queries all encoder states
Attention removes the single-vector bottleneck; the Transformer removes recurrence.
